title: lespedeza thunbergii f. formosa
intro: Lespedeza thunbergii f. formosa, commonly known as the Korean bush clover, is a flowering plant native to East Asia, specifically in China and Korea. The Korean bush clover is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help lower cholesterol levels and reduce blood pressure due to its high content of isoflavones. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including formononetin, isoflavones, and flavonoids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and anti-diabetic properties. The bioactive constituents of Lespedeza thunbergii f. formosa may also contribute to its potential anti-cancer and anti-aging effects.
